# TildaZ v0.10.9

**Faster colored output.**

- Output with ANSI colors and styles is processed about 50% faster on Linux and Windows, and 10% faster on macOS. ([#841](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/841), [benchmarks](https://tildaz.dev/benchmarks/))

## Downloads

| Platform | File | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Linux portable (glibc 2.28+) | `tildaz-v0.10.9-linux-{x86_64,aarch64}.tar.gz` | Extract and run `./install.sh --release`; no `sudo`. |
| Linux Debian / Ubuntu | `tildaz_0.10.9-1_{amd64,arm64}.deb` | Install with `dpkg` or a graphical software installer. |
| Linux Fedora / RHEL / openSUSE | `tildaz-0.10.9-1.{x86_64,aarch64}.rpm` | Install with `dnf` or the distro package tool. |
| Linux distro-independent | `TildaZ-0.10.9-{x86_64,aarch64}.AppImage` | Make executable and run; FUSE is optional. |
| Arch / Manjaro / EndeavourOS | `tildaz-0.10.9-1-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst` | x86_64 package. |
| macOS 15+ universal | `tildaz-v0.10.9-macos.dmg` | Apple Silicon and Intel; stable self-signed identity, not notarized. |
| Windows 10/11 x64 | `tildaz-v0.10.9-win-x64.zip` | Unzip and keep `_internal\` next to `tildaz.exe`. |
| Windows 11 ARM64 | `tildaz-v0.10.9-win-arm64.zip` | ARM64-native binary; same layout as the x64 zip. |
